connectionReference.description: Connection to Microsoft 365 Outlook for monitoring flagged emails and creating Notion tasks

flagMessage.description: Update the flag status on a message

monitoredFolders.description: Email folders to watch for flagged messages

setupInstructions: 1. Sign in to Copilot Studio with your Microsoft 365 account
2. The Outlook connection uses your existing Microsoft 365 authentication
3. Grant Mail.Read and Mail.ReadWrite permissions when prompted
4. No additional configuration required — the flow triggers automatically on flagged emails
